title: QA Contract Specification
description: Declarative service configuration schema establishing the operational contract for autonomous QA preview and demo recording across Frontend, Backend, and Mobile repositories.

$schema.description: URI reference to this JSON schema

serviceType.description: Category of the application service under test

port.description: Localhost TCP port number the service binds and listens on

healthCheckUrl.description: HTTP readiness probe URL path (e.g., /health) or full localhost address

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle command hooks for service provisioning and execution

prepare.description: Command to install dependencies, compile assets, or execute database migrations prior to launch

start.description: Command to start the service process

apiBaseUrlEnvVar.description: Mandatory for frontend services: Name of the environment variable used to override backend API base URL at build/runtime (e.g., NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, VITE_API_URL)

mobileConfig.description: Mandatory for mobile services: Platform, bundle ID, and build output binary path

bundleId.description: Application package or bundle identifier (e.g., com.example.app)

buildOutputPath.description: Relative path to the compiled debug binary (.apk, .aab, or .app)
